# costfluent_cost_summary (Data Source)

Summarize cost over a window, with its change against the window before. This query may be slow.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# September against the 30 days before it.
data "costfluent_cost_summary" "september" {
  start_date = "2026-09-01"
  end_date   = "2026-09-30"
}

output "total_cost" {
  value = data.costfluent_cost_summary.september.total_cost
}

output "cost_change_percent" {
  value = data.costfluent_cost_summary.september.cost_change_percent
}

# Summary for one workspace rather than the provider's default.
data "costfluent_workspace" "prod" {
  name = "Production"
}

data "costfluent_cost_summary" "production" {
  workspace_id = data.costfluent_workspace.prod.id
  start_date   = "2026-09-01"
  end_date     = "2026-09-30"
}

output "production_amortized" {
  value = data.costfluent_cost_summary.production.total_amortized_cost
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_date` (String) Last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `start_date` (String) First day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD).

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Cost filter expression.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. Uses the provider's workspace if not specified, and the whole organization when neither is set.

### Read-Only

- `cost_change` (Number) Absolute change against the previous window of the same length.
- `cost_change_percent` (Number) Percentage change against the previous window of the same length.
- `currency` (String) Currency code.
- `total_amortized_cost` (Number) Total amortized cost.
- `total_cost` (Number) Total cost for the window.
- `total_list_cost` (Number) Total cost at list prices.
